review_description: From quote to installation the whole process was seamless and a pleasure to deal with. A big shout out to the Renewlec team who went over and above and worked overtime to get the job done. I can definitely recommend these guys and would definitely use them again

The process was pretty much seamless.The inspection was well informed with intelligent answers to all queriesThe person doing the inspection was well mannered and was the person doing the installation quote .The quote arrived by email the following day covering all aspects of the installation .All aspects of the installation was taken care of   in a timely manner .I was surprised to see that the installation took place within the week by a well organised crew of four which included the owner manager.The crew were very experienced and did a very tidy job on the complete installation . I have taken photos of the installed units .Customer service was great with backup support to make sure the product was operating as it should .I would definitely have no trouble at all in recommending this supplier and installer  to any body looking for a well priced quality solar system .Alan Parker

After contacting renewlec everything from a quote to installation of our solar panels proceeded quickly and smoothly.Daniel, Ben, and all the installers were efficient and accommodating, we were extremely happy.They are coming back to pigeon proof our panels and have even offered to install the inverter cover we purchased online without charge.Very good business - very happy customers!
Provided exactly what I needed (extra 6.6kW panels, larger inverter, 19.2kW battery), really lovely to work with. Have recommended them to my neighbours!

Cannot fault Renewlec and their team. Dan the owner/sparky does a great job and is super responsive to questions.Ben the sales guy isn't pushy and has the info you need. Quite a bit cheaper than other quotes received. Very impressed.

Renewlec were not pushy, they gave options within our budget and worked around any stumbling blocks. This was incontrast to one of the 3 quotes that we were going to go with).The installers were prompt, friendly, professional and quick. The job was booked in for 3 days after we accepted the quote. They arrived earlier than expected and they were clean. If Renewlec is not listed on Solar Quotes then they should be!
